text: {"lessons":["I tended to sell stocks after gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider the whole portfolio and my plan.","Selling winners felt rewarding, while avoiding a loss could keep me attached to a losing position. I should judge each holding by its prospects, not just its cost basis.","Prices are random, and five periods tell me little about what comes next. I should avoid treating recent moves as reliable signals and trade only when there is a clear reason."]}
